name: smwgraphics-monster-world-iv-genesis-stage
title: Monster World IV (Genesis) - Stage 1
description:
This BG comes from an obscure japanese game on the Mega Drive named Monster World IV, where you play as a girl on an adventure.
BG uses the other half of palette 4.
Credit MarioFanGamer for the Parallax HDMA Toolkit.
The code is in the 'Level' folder and the required file in the 'library' folder.
